title: Route track_management_hub_screen's error text and edit_track_screen's validation sentinel through AppLocalizations
rule: AX-2 (no hardcoded user-facing strings) / EH-5 (no pre-formatted human messages) / custom lint no_e_to_string_in_ui

evidence.quote: name.trim().isEmpty ? 'Track name cannot be empty.' : null;

why: Text('Error: $e') renders a raw, untranslated exception string directly to Hebrew-locale users if activeTracksProvider's stream ever errors — exactly the shape the (currently non-functional) no_e_to_string_in_ui custom lint targets. validateTrackName's hardcoded return string is never actually displayed today (the only call site null-checks it and shows l10n.trackEditNameRequired instead), but returning a natural-language string from a validator invites a future direct-display bug.
recommendation: Replace the error branch with a localized generic error string; change validateTrackName's signature to return bool (or a stable enum) instead of a message string.
acceptance_criteria: No raw Text('Error: $e')-style interpolation remains in tracks/setup presentation code
validateTrackName no longer returns a natural-language string

corrections: Site 2 (validateTrackName) quote matches but is provably dead: the file's own doc comment confirms only nullity is used by the caller, the string itself is never displayed — weaker than a live violation, though the finding itself discloses this honestly rather than overclaiming. Doesn't change P3.
